integrity: All asymptotic claims are analytic, with finite exact distributions and independent ballot enumeration as checks; no independent scientific audit is asserted.
limitations: Three candidates, two-seat Thiele score, fair independent approvals, fixed exact marginal and mathematical score equality; no uniform near-rational or correlated-voter conclusion. The rational \(n^{-1/2}\) order was already in Xia (2025), Theorem 14; new content is the exact coefficients and irrational \(n^{-1}\) law.
title: An arithmetic phase transition in tie probabilities for three-candidate Thiele committees
